jobs.title: Director, Platform Engineering
jobs.description:
CentralReach is a leading provider of autism and IDD care software for Applied Behavior Analysis (ABA), multidisciplinary therapy, and special education. Trusted by more than 200,000 users, we enable therapy providers, educators, and employers to scale the way they deliver ABA and related therapies with innovative technology, market-leading industry expertise, and world-class customer satisfaction.

The Mission

Join a high-growth healthcare SaaS provider dedicated to transforming patient outcomes through seamless technology. We’re looking for a strategic platform leader to scale our engineering culture, strengthen our cloud infrastructure, refine our technical roadmap, and mentor a high-performing team.

The Role

As Director of Platform Engineering, you will bridge business strategy, product delivery, and reliable technical operations. You will oversee the evolution of our cloud platform, developer tooling, deployment practices, observability platforms, and shared engineering services, with a focus on scalability, reliability, security, team velocity, and developer experience. This role will help mature our GitOps operating model, including ArgoCD-driven Kubernetes delivery, environment consistency, deployment visibility, and auditable change management.

What You’ll Do

Lead & Mentor: Manage and grow a multi-functional platform engineering team, fostering a culture of ownership, operational excellence, and strong internal customer partnership.
Platform Architecture: Define and guide the architecture of shared platform capabilities, including cloud infrastructure, CI/CD, GitOps delivery with ArgoCD, observability platforms, identity, developer tooling, and reusable services that support full-stack product teams using C#/.NET, React.js, and SQL Server.
Cloud & Reliability Strategy: Drive our AWS infrastructure strategy, leveraging cloud-native services, automation, containerization, monitoring, and incident response practices for high availability and performance.
Observability & Operational Insight: Champion a modern observability strategy across applications, infrastructure, and data services, including metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, alerting, SLOs, incident response workflows, and executive-level visibility into platform health and customer-impacting reliability trends.
ArgoCD & GitOps Delivery: Establish and improve ArgoCD-based deployment patterns for Kubernetes workloads, ensuring Git remains the source of truth for environment configuration, release promotion, drift detection, rollback, access separation, and auditable production change control.
Compliance First: Ensure all engineering practices meet rigorous security standards (HIPAA, SOC2, & PCI).
Strategic Enablement: Partner with Product, Engineering, Security, and Design to define platform milestones, reduce delivery friction, and enable product teams to iterate confidently toward long-term initiatives.

What You Bring

Experience: 8+ years in software, infrastructure, platform, or DevOps engineering with 3+ years in a senior leadership role.
Technical Depth: Proven track record leading teams that build and operate scalable SaaS platforms. Competency with AWS, Kubernetes, infrastructure automation, CI/CD, ArgoCD, GitOps practices, observability platforms, with the ability to guide platform standards across monitoring, alerting, tracing, deployment automation, and production readiness.
Communication: Ability to translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.
Project Management: Ability to break down complex and long running projects into reasonable milestones that can be used to show progress to stakeholders and keep the ball moving.

Why Us?

Our Mission: To provide the leading software and services platform to help children and adults diagnosed with autism and related IDDs, and those who serve them.
AI-First Innovation: Leverage generative AI technology to enhance team velocity and offer cutting-edge products to our customers.
Award-Winning Culture: We are proud to be recognized as a premier employer, consistently earning top spots on "Best Places to Work" lists by regional and national awards programs.
Exceptional Peers: You’ll collaborate with a talented team of engineers and innovators who are as fun to work with as they are dedicated to excellence.
Challenging Problems: From scaling a high-traffic SaaS platform to navigating complex HIPAA compliance and data security, you will tackle some of the most rewarding technical challenges in the industry.

Base Salary Range

$225,000—$245,000 USD

Recognized as one of the best places to work over 10 times by organizations such as Inc, Built In, and NJBIZ, our culture is centered around impact, inclusion, and flexibility. As a hybrid company with collaborative offices in Ft. Lauderdale, FL; Holmdel, NJ; and Verona, Italy, we foster a workplace where top talent can thrive and make a real difference in the lives of those we serve.

We offer competitive compensation, comprehensive health benefits, generous PTO, 401(k) matching, and paid parental leave to our full-time employees. You'll make sure broken things get fixed, and more importantly, you'll create a detailed program to ensure they don't break in the first place. Communicate with hotel department heads to become aware of maintenance needs and ensure timely response to internal requests.

You’re able to perform in a high-paced environment with multiple tasks and deadlines and able to effectively respond to emergencies.

Although you’ll sometimes be behind the desk, be prepared to move around because you will be standing/sitting, carrying/lifting up to 50 pounds, walking, bending/twisting, climbing stairs and more. Be prepared to be on call at all times in case of emergency including nights, weekends, and holiday. jobs.description:
Ironclad is the leading AI contracting platform that transforms agreements into assets. Contracts move faster, insights surface instantly, and agents push work forward, all with you in control. Whether you’re buying or selling, Ironclad unifies the entire process on one intelligent platform, providing leaders with the visibility they need to stay one step ahead. That’s why the world’s most transformative organizations, from Rivian to the World Health Organization and the Associated Press, trust Ironclad to accelerate their business.

We’re consistently recognized as a leader in the industry: a Leader in the Forrester Wave and Gartner Magic Quadrant for Contract Lifecycle Management, a Fortune Great Place to Work, and one of Fast Company’s Most Innovative Workplaces. Ironclad has also been named to Forbes’ AI 50 and Business Insider’s list of Companies to Bet Your Career On. We’re backed by leading investors including Accel, Y Combinator, Sequoia, BOND, and Franklin Templeton. For more information, visit www.ironcladapp.com or follow us on LinkedIn.

The Role

Ironclad is looking for a Director, GTM Engineering & Systems Architecture to build the agentic systems that will run our revenue organization. This is a hands-on leadership role. You’ll lead a team of GTM engineers, systems architects, and CRM developers while also building out a team of autonomous agents. You will also personally design and ship the automation and AI agents that take over the manual work our Revenue teams do today.

You’ll be responsible for building out a world class revenue tech stack. The stack is already strong, but we need a leader with both experience and a deep vision for what the future of GTM tech looks like and a passion for driving us there. It’s a unique mix of managing vendor relationships, evaluating new tech, consolidating old tech, and building the connections between our data warehouse, CRM, and the autonomous systems that will run Ironclad’s revenue engine.

We’re adding one GTM Engineer to the team this year, and that’s likely it for a while. The goal is getting more out of agents than out of additional hires. This role owns how Ironclad scales GTM operations globally through automation and AI.

What You’ll Own

Agentic Systems & Automation

Design and deploy autonomous agents to automate GTM workflows across Revenue, taking them from prototype to production systems the business relies on daily.
Own how agents connect to the CRM, the data warehouse, and the rest of the revenue stack, including what data they can see and what actions they’re allowed to take.
Implement essential guardrails, ranging from human-in-the-loop reviews for critical decisions to transparent permissioning, ensuring the team understands and trusts the agents' actions.
Stay ahead of where agentic AI is going, and turn that into what Ironclad builds next.

GTM Tech Stack

Set a multi-year vision roadmap for the tools that run the Revenue org, from forecasting and conversation intelligence to outbound engagement and the rest of the stack.
Keep a close eye on the evolving tech landscape, evaluating consolidation opportunities and identifying when legacy tech becomes obsolete.
Measure the adoption and impact of existing tech, partnering with the enablement team to ensure technology is being fully leveraged. And get the most out of existing tech before exploring further investments.

CRM & CPQ Platform

Own Ironclad’s CRM architecture, including CPQ and how it connects to the rest of the revenue stack.
Understand the voice and needs of the end users, staying close to field teams to ensure the system is meeting their needs.
Constantly stay on the search for ways to simplify and automate elements of the deal cycle, reducing the demand for manual and time consuming data entry.

Team & Technical Leadership

Set a technical bar high enough that you could personally build most of what you’d ask someone else to build.

Team Structure

This role reports to the VP, Revenue Operations & Enablement. It leads GTM engineering, systems architects, and CRM/CPQ administration functions. We’re adding one GTM Engineer this year. Autonomous agent development is a core initiative this role owns directly.

What You Bring

8+ years of hands-on experience building AI systems and managing GTM tech stacks.
A proven track record shipping production AI agents or LLM-powered systems. Comfortable with agent frameworks and building with current models.
Experience leading CRM and CPQ platform teams, including architecture, data model, and governance, at a company with GTM complexity.
A genuine builder. You’re comfortable writing code and shipping systems yourself, not just directing engineers who do.
Experience partnering with Revenue and Finance stakeholders, translating GTM needs into systems people actually adopt.
You have a high-ownership mindset and a low ego. You are comfortable running a team with a big, ambitious mandate.

Build underwriting-specific data products, Palantir workflows and analytical tools for portfolio planning, capacity setting and steering.

jobs.title: Director, Sales Solutions Engineering
jobs.description:
Flex is a growth-stage, NYC headquartered FinTech company that is creating the best rent payment experience. It’s hard to believe that it’s 2026 and paying rent on time is expensive, inflexible, and difficult. We’re here to change that! Flex enables our users to pay rent throughout the month on a schedule that better fits their finances and budget. Our mission is to empower as many renters as possible with flexibility over their most significant recurring expense. After deliberately keeping a stealth profile as we built up unprecedented investor support and an enthusiastic user base, we are looking for motivated individuals to help us keep our mission growing. Will you be a part of the team?

About The Role

This role is the tip of the spear for Flex's largest, most complex, and most strategically important deals. As we expand into new verticals and new enterprise relationships, we need a technical sales leader who can do more than present a demo. You'll own the solution layer of the sales process end-to-end: translating complex customer environments into winning proposals, building conviction with technical and executive stakeholders alike, ensuring that what we promise is something we can actually deliver, and working with Product & Engineering teams to ensure customer needs are a key input to internal roadmaps.

This is the founding hire for Flex's New Verticals Solution Engineering function. You'll start as a hands-on, high-impact operator with Director-level scope, and you'll build the foundation the function scales on: the playbooks, the demo environments, the discovery frameworks, and the hiring plan. As new vertical pipeline matures, you will recruit, hire, and lead a team of Solution Engineers, with a defined path to formal people leadership of the SE organization. We are looking for someone who wants to earn that mandate by winning deals first, then scale themselves through a team.

What You'll Do

Own the technical sale on our largest, most complex deals: Lead solution engineering activity for Flex's highest-priority opportunities in new verticals, from discovery and scoping through proof-of-concept, technical validation, and close.
Build trust with technical and executive buyers: Engage executive stakeholders at prospective partners. Translate Flex's capabilities into business outcomes that resonate at the board level and in the weeds equally.
Architect solutions that win and scale: Deeply understand each prospect's technology, data environment, and operational requirements. Design integration and deployment approaches that are commercially compelling and technically sound, working shoulder-to-shoulder with Flex Engineering to validate feasibility before we commit.
Drive proof-of-concept and pilot execution: Lead structured POCs and pilots that de-risk the decision for the customer and accelerate time-to-close. Define success criteria, coordinate Product and Engineering resources, manage execution, and turn results into momentum.
Partner with Sales to shape deal strategy: Function as a true co-owner of the deal alongside the Account Executive, contributing to account strategy, surfacing risks, and helping design the right commercial and technical structure.
Build the New Verticals SE function, not just the playbook: Document discovery frameworks, integration patterns, objection handling, and competitive differentiation as we enter each new vertical. Create reusable assets (demo environments, solution briefs, RFP libraries) that raise the floor for future deals and make every SE hire behind you productive faster.
Define and execute the SE hiring plan: Build the business case for headcount as vertical pipeline scales. Own the hiring bar: write role profiles, design the interview process, recruit, and onboard the first Solution Engineers on the team.
Grow into leading the team: As the function scales, transition from founding IC to player-coach to people leader. Set the operating rhythm, coach SEs on deal execution, and own quality across the SE motion in new verticals.
Partner deeply with Product and Engineering: Operate as the connective tissue between the field and the build. Synthesize technical feedback from deals into structured, prioritized product input, align Engineering on customer requirements during active cycles, and influence the roadmap by making the business case for what new verticals require.
Shape how Flex shows up in market: Partner with Marketing and Business Development on technical content, event presence, and thought leadership that builds Flex's credibility with enterprise buyers in new segments.

Key Qualifications

10+ years of experience in pre-sales, solutions engineering, or technical sales, with at least 4 years operating in a senior or lead capacity on complex enterprise deals.
Demonstrated track record closing large, multi-stakeholder, technically complex sales cycles, ideally in FinTech, PropTech, payments, or adjacent SaaS/infrastructure categories.
Experience building or scaling an SE or technical pre-sales function: hiring SEs, developing talent, and establishing the processes and assets a team runs on. Formal people management experience is a strong plus; demonstrated readiness and ambition to lead a team is required.
Exceptional ability to engage and build credibility with C-suite and VP-level technical buyers; equally comfortable in a boardroom and in a technical architecture review.
Deep fluency in enterprise integration patterns (APIs, webhooks, data pipelines, ERP/property management system ecosystems) with the ability to get hands-on when needed.
Strong commercial instincts: ability to shape deal structure, anticipate objections, and understand how technical decisions affect economics on both sides of the table.
Experience operating in a greenfield or early-stage vertical context. Comfortable building process, playbooks, and teams from scratch rather than inheriting them.
Track record of functioning as a cross-functional bridge: influencing product roadmaps, aligning engineering teams to customer requirements, and partnering closely with marketing and BD.
Outstanding written and verbal communication; the ability to distill complex technical and financial concepts into clear, persuasive narratives for diverse audiences.
High ownership orientation: someone who treats the customer's success as their own, moves urgently without needing to be told to, and multiplies their impact through the people they hire and develop.
FinTech, real estate technology, or multi-sided marketplace experience is a strong plus.

Compensation

Flex takes a market-based approach to pay, ensuring compensation is commensurate with a candidate's experience and our internal leveling guidelines. For candidates located in our Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area) and Tier 3 (Salt Lake City) markets, the base salary pay range for this role is below. Flex utilizes a geographic pay differential based on a cost of labor index. If you are located outside of the cities listed below, your starting pay will be adjusted to align with the market conditions of your specific geographic zone. Please speak with your recruiter for additional information regarding the specific range for your location.

Tier 1 (NYC/Bay Area)

$232,000—$290,000 USD

Tier 3 (Salt Lake City)

$197,200—$246,500 USD

Life at Flex

We understand that it takes a diverse team of highly intelligent, curious, determined, empathetic, and self aware people to grow a successful company. Our HQ is located in New York City, but we have employees located throughout the US, Australia, Canada and South America. We are growing quickly, but deliberately, with a focus on building an inclusive culture. Our dynamic team has incredible perspectives to share, just as we know you do, and we take great pride in being an equal opportunity workplace.

Offices

Roles posted in New York, San Francisco, and Salt Lake City are hybrid positions with on-site expectations of 2-3 days per week in our local offices. For candidates outside of these areas, you may be eligible for our relocation assistance program.

Benefits

Competitive medical, dental, and vision
Company equity
401(k) plan with company match

Free Flex subscription
